Gladstone Service Centre

Centrelink + Medicare + Veterans Services

Gladstone Service Centre is at Shop 27-32B, Gladstone Central Shopping Centre, 45-69 Dawson Highway, West Gladstone, QLD 4680. This Services Australia office handles Centrelink + Medicare + Veterans Services services for residents of West Gladstone and surrounding suburbs. Call Centrelink on 13 24 68.

Services available at this centre

Gladstone Service Centre provides the following services:

  • Centrelink services — JobSeeker, Age Pension, Disability Support Pension, Youth Allowance, Family Tax Benefit, Parenting Payment, Carer Payment, and more. See all Centrelink payments.
  • Medicare services — enrolment, Medicare card replacement, claims, and family health cover. Learn about Medicare services.
  • Veterans Information Service — DVA support, pensions, and entitlements for current and former Australian Defence Force members.

How to prepare for your visit

Before visiting Gladstone Service Centre, prepare the following:

  • Photo ID — driver licence, passport, or Australian birth certificate.
  • myGov account — if you have one, link Centrelink/Medicare beforehand at my.gov.au to speed things up.
  • Bank details — BSB and account number if applying for or updating payments.
  • Proof of address — recent utility bill or bank statement.
  • Income or evidence documents — relevant to the claim you're making (payslips, medical certificates, custody papers, etc.).
  • Interpreter request — if needed, call 131 450 (TIS National) before your visit to arrange one for free.

For a full step-by-step before-you-visit checklist, see what to bring to Centrelink.

Booking an appointment

Many Centrelink services can be done online via myGov. For services that need an in-person visit, you can book an appointment by calling 13 24 68 (Centrelink general line) or visiting the centre during opening hours. Walk-in service is available, but waits vary with the time of day, so booking is the safer option.

For step-by-step instructions, see how to book a Centrelink appointment.

Frequently asked questions

What's the wait time at Gladstone Service Centre?

Wait times vary by time of day and time of month, and Services Australia does not publish them per centre. Call 13 24 68 to ask about current wait times or to book an appointment.

Can I do my Centrelink business online instead?

Yes. Most Centrelink and Medicare services are available via myGov — claims, payment history, updating details, uploading documents, and reporting income. In-person visits are usually only needed for identity verification, document originals, or complex situations. See services online vs. in person.

Is the West Gladstone office accessible?

Most Services Australia centres have wheelchair access, hearing loops, and provide interpreter services on request (call 131 450). Specific accessibility features for Gladstone Service Centre can be confirmed by calling 13 24 68 before your visit.

What's the difference between Centrelink and Medicare here?

Gladstone Service Centre is a combined service centre. Centrelink handles welfare and income support payments (JobSeeker, Age Pension, family payments, etc.). Medicare handles health-related services (Medicare card, claims for medical visits, vaccination records). Both can usually be done at the same centre in one visit.
